A bright pasta for a weeknight. Ready in twenty minutes.

## Ingredients

- 400 g spaghetti
- 2 lemons, zest and juice
- 60 g butter
- 1/2 cup grated parmesan
- salt and black pepper

## Directions

1. Boil the spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
2. Melt the butter in a wide pan and add the lemon zest.
3. Toss the drained pasta with the butter, lemon juice and parmesan.
   Add a splash of pasta water if it looks dry.

## Notes

Keeps for a day in the fridge. Add fresh lemon juice when reheating.
